dossier.stage_and_modality: Clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies with CD19-targeted programs entering clinical development.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases, with CD19 CAR-T programs specifically targeting autoimmune conditions.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology that generates CAR-T cells directly within patients rather than ex vivo manufacturing.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach eliminates traditional ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing complexities and enables direct generation of therapeutic cells in patients.
dossier.last_significant_event: Raised $122 million Series B funding in May 2026 and appointed three new clinical/scientific advisory board members including autoimmune expert Georg Schett.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with in vivo gene editing approach for multiple therapeutic areas including CAR-T applications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Strongest preclinical data to date for in vivo sickle cell therapy presented at ASGCT 2026, along with new CAR-T application data.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD) in Phase 1/2 clinical trial targeting PiZZ genotype patients with lung and/or liver disease. Sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications in preclinical development.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo gene editing platform technology enabling direct therapeutic modification without ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach that challenges traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy methods by enabling direct gene editing within the patient.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of new preclinical data for sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing antigen-driven CAR-T (adCAR-T) expansion methods as an alternative to traditional ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical proof-of-concept data presented at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.delivery_approach: Antigen-driven CAR-T expansion method that bypasses manufacturing bottlenecks while avoiding systemic vector delivery risks associated with in vivo approaches.
dossier.key_differentiators: adCAR-T platform aims to combine advantages of ex vivo and in vivo CAR-T by enabling rapid, physiological CAR-T programming without manufacturing constraints or systemic delivery risks.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical proof-of-concept data at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T approach using UB-VV111 for hematologic malignancies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting patients in Phase 1 dose-escalation study for UB-VV111, but no efficacy or safety data has been disclosed yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) and chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) within broader B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma indications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 recruiting trial NCT06528301 for UB-VV111 in B-cell lymphomas.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with CPTX2309 asset currently recruiting in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, focusing on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapy with lead asset KLN-1010 currently recruiting patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: 100% response rate reported in early data from the first-in-human Phase 1 inMMyCAR study of KLN-1010 presented at ASCO 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma with KLN-1010 targeting BCMA.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology, though specific delivery mechanism not disclosed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and achieved notable 100% response rate in early clinical data.
dossier.last_significant_event: Updated first-in-human Phase 1 data showing 100% response rate presented at ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting in May 2026, leading to acquisition by Lilly.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies delivered via direct injection. Multiple investigator-initiated trials are recruiting or preparing to recruit patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory B-cell malignancies (B-ALL, B-NHL, multiple myeloma) and refractory autoimmune diseases. All trials target treatment-resistant patient populations.
dossier.delivery_approach: Direct injection delivery platform with distinct assets JY231 (targeting CD19 for B-cell malignancies) and JY232 (targeting BCMA for multiple myeloma). Also developing dual CD19/BCMA targeting approach for autoimmune diseases.
dossier.key_differentiators: Multi-asset in vivo CAR-T platform spanning both oncology and autoimmune applications. Developing both single-target (CD19, BCMA) and dual-target (CD19/BCMA) approaches within the same delivery system.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting for multiple Phase 1 trials in 2024, including NCT07336823 for JY232 in multiple myeloma and NCT06890065 for JY231 in B-cell malignancies.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo approach using assets HN2301 and HN2302 for autoimmune indications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma (systemic sclerosis).
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06801119 for systemic lupus erythematosus and scleroderma, currently recruiting patients with HN2301.

dossier.indications_pursued: Cancer, autoimmune diseases, and systemic rheumatic diseases based on published research focus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T generation using both viral and non-viral vectors, with nanotechnology enhancements.
dossier.key_differentiators: Eliminates ex vivo manufacturing bottlenecks by enabling scalable in vivo CAR-T production and immediate treatment delivery.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell engineering using their TRAC platform technology.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First-in-primate data demonstrating successful in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering, presented at ASGCT Annual Meeting.
dossier.delivery_approach: TRAC platform technology for direct in vivo engineering of CAR-T cells.
dossier.key_differentiators: TRAC platform enables direct in vivo CAR-T cell engineering, eliminating the need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and manipulation.
dossier.last_significant_event: Late-breaking oral presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting showcasing first-in-primate in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering data (May 2026).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with gene therapy approach for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease using EN-374.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting participants for Phase 1/2 trial of EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease to evaluate safety and identify optimal dose level.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374, plus broader chronic granulomatous disease research.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiated recruiting for Phase 1/2 trial NCT06876363 testing EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical trials with ex vivo CAR-T assets (SC262, SC291) and preclinical in vivo CAR-T platform (SG293). Company operates dual approach with both traditional and in vivo CAR-T modalities.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for SG293 surrogate demonstrated cell-specific delivery, potent CAR-T cell generation, and deep B cell depletion in non-human primates. Clinical data from Phase 1 trials with SC262 and SC291 has not been reported.
dossier.indications_pursued: Oncology indications including non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform utilizing cell-specific delivery mechanism. SG293 represents the lead in vivo asset with demonstrated targeted delivery capabilities.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual platform approach combining traditional ex vivo CAR-T therapies with proprietary in vivo CAR-T technology. Cell-specific delivery mechanism for in vivo CAR-T generation distinguishes from other in vivo approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of preclinical data for in vivo CAR-T therapy SG293 in May 2026, demonstrating successful in vivo CAR-T generation and B cell depletion in non-human primates.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 trials ongoing with oral small molecule BTK inhibitor EVER001 and intramuscular vaccine EVM14. No in vivo CAR-T approaches identified in the available data.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 trial for Nefecon in IgA nephropathy completed in Chinese patients. Phase 2 trial recruiting for EVER001 in multiple kidney diseases including MCD and IgAN.
dossier.indications_pursued: Kidney diseases including IgA nephropathy, minimal change disease, FSGS, and primary membranous nephropathy with EVER001. Solid tumors including squamous non-small cell lung cancer with EVM14 vaccine.
dossier.delivery_approach: Oral administration for EVER001 BTK inhibitor and intramuscular injection for EVM14 vaccine in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is described as a highly selective, oral, reversible covalent BTK inhibitor that acts on multiple immune pathways without directly affecting T cells or depleting B cells.
dossier.last_significant_event: Phase 1/2 trial for EVM14 in solid tumors initiated and recruiting patients for intramuscular administration alone and in combination with pembrolizumab.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles. Currently has two Phase 1 trials recruiting, including one for autoimmune diseases using CD19 CAR-T approach.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome for relapsed and refractory patients. Also developing ORN252 asset being tested in healthy volunteers.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) targeting T cells that encapsulate circular RNA encoding chimeric antigen receptors. Uses circular RNA platform technology for in vivo CAR-T delivery.
dossier.key_differentiators: Utilizes circular RNA instead of traditional mRNA or DNA vectors for CAR expression in vivo CAR-T applications. Targets autoimmune diseases rather than oncology indications typical of most CAR-T approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiated Phase 1 clinical trial for autoimmune diseases (NCT07413341) and announced plans to showcase clinical-ready circular RNA pipeline at 2026 ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing conventional CAR-T cell therapies. Currently has three active clinical trials recruiting patients across multiple myeloma and hepatocellular carcinoma indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Ori-C101 (GPC3 CAR-T) achieved 66.7% overall response rate in late-line hepatocellular carcinoma patients as reported at ASCO 2026. This represents the most advanced efficacy data disclosed by the company.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with anti-GPRC5D CAR-T (OriCAR-017) and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with GPC3-directed CAR-T (Ori-C101). Both represent hematologic and solid tumor applications respectively.
dossier.delivery_approach: Conventional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy approach using modified T cell injections. No indication of in vivo delivery technology based on available trial descriptions.
dossier.key_differentiators: Targeting GPRC5D for multiple myeloma and GPC3 for hepatocellular carcinoma with reported best-in-class potential for the HCC program. Pursuing both liquid and solid tumor applications simultaneously.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of Ori-C101 clinical data at ASCO 2026 showing 66.7% ORR in late-line hepatocellular carcinoma patients, reported as having best-in-class potential.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1b/2 clinical stage company developing ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies. All disclosed programs use autologous CAR-T approaches rather than in vivo delivery.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: ZEVORCABTAGENE AUTOLEUCEL has reached commercial availability for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, as evidenced by post-marketing Phase IV studies. CT041 targeting claudin18.2 is in active Phase 1b/2 trials for gastric and pancreatic cancers.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma (commercialized), solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Focus spans both hematologic malignancies and digestive system cancers.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell manufacturing and infusion platform. No in vivo CAR-T delivery approaches disclosed in current clinical portfolio.
dossier.key_differentiators: CT041 targets claudin18.2 for solid tumor applications including gastric and pancreatic cancers. CT011 is being evaluated in hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence after surgical resection.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of CT011 Phase Ib trial for hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence (NCT06560827, currently recruiting).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early clinical stage with both in vivo CAR-T (IMV101, IMV102) and ex vivo CAR-T (IMC002) approaches. The company has progressed to Phase 3 with IMC002 for gastric cancer.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 trial (NCT07103668) evaluating IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma, comparing objective response rate and progression-free survival versus investigator's choice of treatment. Multiple Phase 1 trials are recruiting for both hematologic and solid tumor indications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell NHL and multiple myeloma. Solid tumors focused on CLDN18.2-positive digestive system cancers including gastric, pancreatic, and esophagogastric junction adenocarcinomas.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach utilizing both in vivo CAR-T delivery (IMV101, IMV102) and traditional ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell therapy (IMC002). All approaches target specific tumor antigens including CLDN18.2.
dossier.key_differentiators: Mixed modality platform combining in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T approaches within the same company pipeline. Focus on CLDN18.2 targeting for solid tumors represents specialization in challenging indication for CAR-T therapy.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 3 trial (NCT07103668) for IMC002 in CLDN18.2-positive gastric adenocarcinoma, representing advancement to late-stage clinical development.
